description: Owner feel test 2026-11-10: parked on flat with the parking brake (P) ON, D selected, full throttle for 10 s. The truck must not drive away; then P released, full throttle: normal launch.
spec: docs/04 s6.1, s6.2; ADR 0004 addendum 2026-11-10 (parking-brake interlock)

checks.source: owner requirement 2026-11-10: with P applied the truck must not drive off (speed stays ~0 for 10 s of full throttle)
no creep through the parking brake (tyre/driveline wind-up only)
drive-away interlock raises the parking-brake warning (cluster/HUD, chime)
no warning once P is released
interlock keeps the clutch open: no slip heating against the spring brakes
engine must not stall against the parking brake
after P release the launch is normal (launch_flat_comb laden40 reaches ~30 km/h ~15 s after the start)
no solver explosion against the brakes
